practiceSection.title: Common Strumming Mistakes
items: Rushing the Tempo: Always practice with a metronome. Internal timing develops through consistent practice at steady tempos.
Too Much Arm Movement: Use wrist motion for fluid strumming. Arm movement should be minimal and natural.
Heavy Upstrokes: Upstrokes should be lighter than downstrokes. Let the pick glide across the strings on the way up.
Ignoring Dynamics: Vary your strumming intensity to support the song's emotional content and arrangement.
